Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
org.openjfx.engine.GameEngine
public class GameEngine extends Object
GameEngine handles the core of the game and the matches. it acts as a controller of the game state, coordinating interactions between the model layer (GameState, Card, Player) and the view (GameView). It handles turn rotation and card mechanics (like skips, reverses, and penalties), UNO declarations(and its failure), and bots. Its statistics are kept by GameStats and MatchStats

    • humanDrawCard

      public void humanDrawCard()
      Checks conditions in drawing from the deck and acts accordingly. The player can only draw once. Forces the human to draw if no card can be currently played. The turn ends if no card can be played even after drawing, otherwise continues.

    • endTurn

      public void endTurn()
      Checks if the match is over (according to whether it's a classic match or scoreBased).
      If one player has zero cards in their hand, there are two scenarios:

      If the gameMode is ClassicGame, the game ends and the player wins immediately.

      If the game mode is ScoreBasedGame, it checks if the player has reached the target score.
      If that's the case, the player wins immediately.

      Otherwise, a new match starts and the current player receives the points from the remaining cards in the other players' hands. It continues until the target score is reached by one player.
